tracked_patterns.name: Change of Character
tracked_patterns.evidence: Price was making lower lows and lower highs prior to 08:30, then impulsively broke above the most recent swing high with a large volume spike, shifting market structure from bearish to bullish.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Follow-through confirmation to sustain the new bullish structure.

tracked_patterns.name: Bullish Flag
tracked_patterns.evidence: Sharp upward impulse to approximately 1740 followed by slight downward drift and consolidation near current price 1723.65.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Clear breakout above flag resistance near 1740 to confirm bullish continuation.

tracked_patterns.name: Liquidity Sweep
tracked_patterns.evidence: Wick down to approximately 1700 around 08:00 before strong reversal rally to 1740, indicating stop liquidity was swept below prior lows.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: None; sweep and reversal are visible.

tracked_patterns.name: Fair Value Gap
tracked_patterns.evidence: Large impulsive bullish candle around 08:00 created a visible price imbalance; price is currently retracing into the gap zone near 1722.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Price reaction/bounce from the FVG to confirm support and continuation.

tracked_patterns.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
tracked_patterns.evidence: Price broke above prior swing highs around 1720-1730 during the 08:30 impulse with high volume, shifting structure from bearish/neutral to bullish. Currently retracing to 1722.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Sustained hold above broken structure; confirmation of higher low formation.

tracked_patterns.name: Symmetrical Triangle
tracked_patterns.evidence: Price action compressing with lower highs from approximately 1740 and higher lows near 1715-1720.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Additional oscillations to confirm converging trendlines and a decisive breakout in either direction.

tracked_patterns.name: Double Bottom
tracked_patterns.evidence: Two distinct swing lows formed near the 1700 level before the impulsive rally above the 1725 neckline with high volume.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: None; breakout has occurred but price is currently near the neckline retest zone.

tracked_patterns.name: Bearish Flag
tracked_patterns.evidence: A sharp upward impulse from ~1700 to ~1740 is followed by a downward-sloping consolidation near the highs.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Clear parallel flag channel and breakdown below the lower trendline are not yet fully established.

tracked_patterns.name: Double Top
tracked_patterns.evidence: Price formed a peak near the 1740 resistance zone, pulled back to approximately 1715, and is approaching a second peak near 1735-1740 before rolling over at current price ~1725.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Confirmation requires a decisive close below the neckline support around 1715-1720.

tracked_patterns.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
tracked_patterns.evidence: Rejection from approximately 1740 highs with price currently at 1723.65 showing short-term weakness after the impulse.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Clear break below recent swing low near 1710-1715 to confirm bearish structure shift.

tracked_patterns.name: Head and Shoulders
tracked_patterns.evidence: Left shoulder formed near 1720, head at 1740, right shoulder developing near current price around 1718-1725.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Right shoulder completion and decisive breakdown below neckline support near 1705-1710.

tracked_patterns.name: Break of Structure (BOS)
tracked_patterns.evidence: Price broke above prior range resistance around 1720-1730 with a high-volume impulse candle, establishing a new swing high near 1740.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Sustained hold above the broken structure as support; current pullback is testing this level.

tracked_patterns.name: Fair Value Gap (FVG)
tracked_patterns.evidence: Large impulsive upward candle likely left a price imbalance/FVG between roughly 1715 and 1730.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Price retracement into the gap zone for potential reaction.

tracked_patterns.name: Break of Structure
tracked_patterns.evidence: Strong impulsive candle near 08:45 broke above prior swing high around 1730 with elevated volume, shifting short-term structure bullish
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Sustained close above structure level or successful retest to confirm BOS

tracked_patterns.name: Change of Character
tracked_patterns.evidence: Prior bullish structure with higher highs is being challenged by rejection at 1740 and downward price action toward the recent higher low.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Clear break below the most recent swing low (~1705-1710) to confirm bearish CHoCH.

tracked_patterns.name: Shooting Star
tracked_patterns.evidence: A candle with a long upper wick extending above 1740 and a small body near the open is visible at the recent high, suggesting intraday rejection.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Follow-through bearish candle(s) closing below the shooting star low to confirm the reversal signal.

The latest candle may still be forming.
